scope: Real immutable 702893-report search derivative, local filesystem range adapter; not internet or browser latency

runtime.requestsRequire: HTTP206, exact Content-Range including pack size, exact byte length

metadataSupplement.supplementalMatches: An empty array for every normalized query leaf; intentionally tests raw preserved text only
metadataSupplement.overlayCoverageTests: tests/test_search_runtime.mjs and tests/test_search_catalog.mjs separately cover leaf unions and AND split between raw and corrected metadata

limits: Local adapter reads only requested file ranges; no server, network RTT, throttling, CORS, mobile browser or cellular conditions were measured.
Quoted phrases and punctuation are verified against independently compressed text pages; soil sample required 584 requests and may be appreciably slower over a network despite bounded concurrency.
Common fragment accelerators avoid thousands of small posting requests: red had 2001 warm range requests before acceleration and one afterward, preserving its exact 377638-report count.

Memory values are Node process observations across sequential queries, not browser requirements or measured peak residency. Broad one-character queries return the entire corpus and use larger transient result sets.
No corpus copy or new large artifact was created for this smoke run. The adapter read the existing D: derivative in place.
